searchText: I heard there was some devnet testing around slashable blobs, curious if anyone knows who wrote the broadcast impl for this, wanted to test a few things on some local testnets around this behaviour. Hey, it's all here: https://github.com/marioevz/blobber/tree/main/proposal_actions for the broadcast we are importing prysm code, it generates a dummy devp2p peer and broadcasts from there Here's the broadcast code: https://github.com/marioevz/blobber/blob/main/p2p/broadcast.go thanks If you're doing basic things and using kurtosis already, its built in: https://github.com/kurtosis-tech/ethereum-package/pull/401 we haven't tested slashing in kt yet
